prompt: Which art dealership did Peter Arrell Browne Widener buy "Portrait of Elena Grimaldi Cattaneo" from in 1906?
answer: Peter Arrell Browne Widener acquired **“Portrait of Elena Grimaldi Cattaneo” from Trotti et Cie., Paris**. The painting was subsequently handled in joint accounts with **P. & D. Colnaghi** and **M. Knoedler & Co.** before its 1908 sale to Widener.
